Name: SONAR - Fishing Addict
Author: Schnupps
Description:
[size=4][b]Mornin’ fishing fans![/b][/size]

SONAR Fishing Addict has some nifty features to improve fishing:

[b]Fishing Speedup: [/b]Speed up both game time and the bite timer while fishing, so a bite arrives sooner in real time (2x-6x). No cheat — the same number of fish can be caught per in-game day, just with less real-world waiting.

[b]SONAR Spot Compass: [/b]An alert with an on-screen compass when a fishing bubble or panning spot appears nearby,

[b]SONAR Fish Scanner: [/b]Shows what could be caught at a given spot along with each catch’s probability, either automatically when casting or on right-click.

The now crucial sonar is available for purchase from Willy right from the start, rather than being locked behind Fishing Level 6.

[b]Tackle: [/b]can be stacked in the inventory, and automatically reloads from inventory when a piece breaks; an on-screen display shows the currently attached bait and tackle count and durability.

[b]More: [/b]An optional autohook option removes the need to manually hook a biting fish. Treasure chests can gain minor additional loot, and more little [s]eggs[/s] things.
Local splitscreen and multiplayer support.

[b]All features are highly customizable.[/b]



[size=5][b]Detailed Features and Options[/b][/size]

This mod has four independent sections, matching the in-game config menu (GMCM supported, not required).

[size=4][b]1. Fishing Speedup[/b][/size]

While fishing, game time and the bite rate are both sped up, so a bite happens sooner in real time. This is balanced, since it doesn’t let you catch more fish in a single in-game day. Fully compatible with the TimeSpeed mod.

[list]
[*][b]Enable Speedup[/b] - Master switch for the fishing speedup feature. Does not affect the SONAR or Other sections.[/*]
[*][b]Speed Multiplier[/b] - How much faster game time and biting time pass, while waiting for a bite. 2x-6x[/*]
[*][b]Disable After Midnight[/b] - If enabled, the speedup automatically turns off after midnight (00:00).[/*]
[*][b]Disable In Bubbles[/b] - If enabled, the speedup pauses while your bobber is in a fishing bubble spot.[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Speedup Keybind[/b] - Press this key in-game to toggle the speedup on/off.[/*]
[*][b]Show Speedup Status Messages[/b] - For testing: shows a HUD message whenever the speedup actually turns on/off.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Game-Time Speed[/b] - If enabled, both players can speed up the shared in-game clock while fishing (does not stack if both fish at once). If disabled (default), only the bite-rate speedup works, but the clock itself won’t be sped up. Has no effect in singleplayer.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]2. SONAR: Spot Compass[/b][/size]

While having a sonar in your inventory or attached to a fishing rod, you get an alert when a fishing bubble or panning spot appears on your map. To make the compass appear, a fishing rod or sonar must be selected.

[list]
[*][b]Enable Fishing Spot Sonar[/b] - Alerts you when a fishing bubble spot appears on your map. Select fishing rod or sonar for the compass to appear.[/*]
[*][b]Enable Panning Spot Sonar[/b] - Alerts you when a panning spot appears on your map. Select fishing rod or sonar for the compass to appear.[/*]
[*][b]No Sonar Needed[/b] - If enabled, the spot alerts will always show up. You still have to select your fishing rod or sonar for the compass to appear. Has no effect if “Attached Sonar Needed” is enabled.[/*]
[*][b]Attached Sonar Needed[/b] - If enabled, the compass and spot-found messages only work while a sonar is actually attached to a fishing rod you’re carrying - not just loose in your inventory. Overrides “No Sonar Needed”.[/*]
[*][b]Play Sound[/b] - Plays a sonar ping sound effect whenever a fishing or panning spot is found.[/*]
[*][b]Compass Scale[/b] - Scales the size of the fishing/panning compass icons. Default = 100%.[/*]
[*][b]Compass On Top Edge[/b] - If enabled, the fishing/panning compass icons are anchored to the top edge of the screen instead of the bottom. Default = off.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]3. SONAR: Fish Scanner[/b][/size]

Two ways to scan for catchable fish, as well as their probabilities: Fishing Scanner triggers automatically when you cast, Clicking Scanner triggers on right-click near water.
Each possible catch is listed with its name and probability. Fish you haven’t caught before are shown as a silhouette with “???” until you land one for real.

[list]
[*][b]Fishing Scanner[/b] - Casting your line with a sonar attached to the rod automatically scans the tile it lands on for fish. If Clicking Scanner is also enabled, this works even without an attached sonar - it just has to be in your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Clicking Scanner[/b] - Right-click with a sonar selected, or a fishing rod (as long as a sonar is in your inventory), to scan the nearest water tile and show what can be caught there.[/*]
[*][b]No Sonar Needed[/b] - Applies to Fishing Scanner and Clicking Scanner. If enabled, neither needs a sonar - a selected fishing rod is enough.[/*]
[*][b]Play Sound[/b] - Plays a sonar ping sound effect whenever either Fish Scanner is used.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Scanner Scale[/b] - Scales the size of the Fish Scanner’s info box. Default = 100%.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Scanner Rows Per Column[/b] - How many fish to list before starting a new column.[/*]
[/list]If you want a more sophisticated scanner use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8970]Fishing Info Overlays[/url] by barteke2.

[size=4][b]4. Other[/b][/size]

Each option here is independent of everything else in the mod.

[list]
[*][b]Enable Autohook[/b] - Automatically performs the hook click the instant a fish bites. The fishing minigame afterward is unaffected.[/*]
[*][b]Stackable Tackle[/b] - Lets unused (full-durability) tackle stack up to 999 in your inventory. You can disable this if you use another mod that also changes item stacking, to avoid conflicts.[/*]
[*][b]Extra Treasure Loot[/b] - A chance for a bit of basic extra loot in fishing treasure chests, on top of their normal contents.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Gear Warning[/b] - Shows an overhead icon and a message when your tackle is about to break, or your bait is about to run out.[/*]
[*][b]More Expensive Sonar[/b] - Raises the sonar’s price at Willy’s to 1,200g, and adds a Gold Bar to its crafting recipe. Well balanced together with “Attached Sonar Needed” enabled and “Clicking Scanner” disabled.[/*]
[*][b]Display Tackle and Bait[/b] - Shows the icon and count of attached bait, and the attached tackle’s icon with remaining durability, in the top-left corner while a fishing rod is equipped. Scales with the Fish Scanner Scale setting.[/*]
[*][b]Tackle Reload[/b] - If a tackle breaks and you have another one of the same kind somewhere in your inventory, a single fresh one is automatically attached to the rod in its place.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: SONAR – Fishing Addict
Manifest.Description: Balanced fish-bite and game-time speedup during fishing, without cheating. Sonar alerts for fishing and panning spots, with a compass to find them. Sonar Fish Scanner shows possible catches with probabilities. Stackable, auto-reloading tackle, with count/durability display. Autohook and more. All configurable.
